moments_are: Every first call of a planning step, in the eight logs of brain/logs that have an escalation or a planner step while dead, that (a) was escalated (37: 25 with the character dead, 4 after code refused to go back, 6 with a goal that kept failing (the corpse out of reach three times, a purchase three times) and 2 after a hunt ended in a leave), (b) came right after code refused to go back and was not escalated (5), or (c) was the first step after a resurrection (36). One warrior, Brutus, around Britain, 2026-10-09/10.
how: Played out as Planner.choose does: today's system prompt and tools, the user turn as logged, the model's world queries answered until it names a goal (scripts/hard_moments.py). One answer a moment a model.
limits: one sample a moment: a second ask can differ
world queries answered from a copy of the local store as it is on 2026-10-10, in code's own order (no Jev re-rank); "seen recently" in an answer counts from now
remember and long_goal acknowledged, not kept; recall by keyword from what the character remembered then
the logged choices were made under the prompt of their day and are not compared here: all three models were asked again
right and wrong are scripts/hard_moments.py's verdict rules, with the hand readings below; open is a move neither settles
cost_note: cost_a_step is as billed here, where the fixed prompt and tools (8,972 tokens) were cached after each model's first call. cost_a_step_uncached is the same tokens with nothing cached before the step, as an escalation in play finds it (they come minutes apart): the logs' own Sonnet escalations cost $0.023 a call on average in mem-a (24 calls), $0.028 at the median.
